note: db-lyon/ue-mcp, the Unreal Engine MCP server (npm package ue-mcp plus the UE_MCP_Bridge editor plugin). The three source files are byte-for-byte copies of docs/tool-reference.md, docs/configuration.md and docs/guards.md at tag v1.4.14, downloaded on 2026-11-19 (the version pinned on the rig). effects.json is derived from the published npm package ue-mcp@1.4.14 by extract/ue_mcp_entries.py (static reading of the package source, nothing executed); an action no table names is 'unclassified' and treated as a change. The tool reference is generated, so counts and wording follow upstream. Which actions the WatooM route allows is a separate, internal fact: see the watoom-ue-route product.
